title: The semantic boundary
description: Callers ask a playlist question. PlaylistRules owns the cache, identity, lifetime, and invalidation needed to answer it.

nodes.title: Semantic playlist question
nodes.detail: Does this cell, target, or rule match?

nodes.title: PlaylistRules
nodes.detail: Presents a stable meaning to callers.

nodes.title: Private cache machinery
nodes.detail: Reuses answers for a defined identity and lifetime.

nodes.title: Explicit invalidation
nodes.detail: Events clear or rebuild the affected derived state.

nodes.title: Answer returned to the resolver
nodes.detail: The caller does not need to know how the answer was produced.
